about: Austin's Chief rules, generalized for base (2026-11-23, https://github.com/manaflow-ai/cmux/issues/52990): "send claude" on several tasks starts one agent chat per task itself (`cmux agents chat new`, its own workspace at the top, Claude on Opus 5.5 at medium effort per https://github.com/manaflow-ai/cmux/issues/57789), never a helper that starts the others

turns.text: send claude on each of these: fix the flaky login test, add a dark mode toggle to settings, update the README install steps

checks.rubric: Passes when the Chief starts one Claude agent chat per task itself (three `cmux agents chat new` calls with --harness claude, each in a new workspace at the top named for its task), each prompt carrying the user's words for its task and telling the agent to open a pull request and keep going until it is ready, on --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort medium. Filing an issue per task first is fine. Fails when it spawns a subagent or a helper to start the agents, puts two tasks in one chat, opens a terminal, or asks the user anything first.
